t: Buy The Book Used Bookstore – 2894 S. Huron, Kawkawlin | 989.684.7876
s: Many years ago, when I was preparing to become a high school English and reading teacher, a professor told me the most important indicator of a student’s reading aptitude was the number of books in his/her home. I actually did visit my students in their homes and found that my professor was right. I was lucky enough to have parents who read and who encouraged a love of reading. In my experience, a love of reading can take you places you never dreamed you might go. At Buy The Book, we have all kinds of books and no, I have not read them all.
